wins: Consistently completed the reconnaissance phase within time budget, enabling rapid insight collection (ep001_step05, ep001_step07).
Maintained high reward accumulation through precise credential harvesting sequences despite overall mission failure (ep001_step12).
fails: Failed to progress past the final privilege escalation checkpoint, resulting in 0% mission success despite decent intermediate performance (ep001_step18).
Overrelied on limited exploit vectors, leading to repeated detection and termination before achieving mission objectives (ep001_step16).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and credential gathering were effective, but the run collapsed at privilege escalation due to insufficient exploitation variety and preparation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts terminate frequently because exploitation preconditions (e.g., writing to /tmp) were not satisfied.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to enumerate authentication methods and user lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When default credentials fail during initial SMB access
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate credential brute-force with focused wordlist and log both successes and failures for pattern analysis

skill_cards.if_condition: When filesystem access is limited after initial foothold
skill_cards.then_action: Search for writable directories before launching escalation attempts to ensure staging area availability

memory_ops.reason: High reward contribution through effective SSH reconnaissance

next_experiments.title: Expand privilege escalation payload set
next_experiments.description: Introduce additional escalation payloads that prepare writable staging areas to avoid precondition failures observed in prior runs.

next_experiments.title: Diversify exploitation triggers
next_experiments.description: Trigger multiple exploitation vectors sequentially (SMB, web service) to reduce dependency on a single chain and detect alternative attack surfaces.

next_experiments.title: Automate writable directory discovery
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated detection of writable directories before escalation attempts to ensure environment readiness and reduce failure rate.
